source: docs/research/agent-skills.md section 1.4 and 4.4 (host docs as documented on 2026-10-03)
note: Install into agents + claude-code by default. Cursor and OpenCode also scan .claude/skills, so installing into every compatible dir at one scope produces duplicates. Other hosts are opt-in.

hosts.name: Claude Code
hosts.notes: does not document .agents/skills; plugin skills would be namespaced /cstack:<skill>

hosts.name: Codex
hosts.notes: drops skills with descriptions over 1024 chars; optional <skill>/agents/openai.yaml generated from skill.meta.json host_overrides

hosts.name: Cursor
hosts.notes: also reads .agents/skills and .claude/skills; do not install to both

hosts.name: Gemini CLI
hosts.notes: activation asks the user for consent; .agents/skills alias wins within a tier

hosts.name: OpenCode
hosts.notes: enforces name regex ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$ and name == directory
